name: Charger
trigger: You took the Dash action
description: Once you have used your action to Dash, spend your bonus action on one melee weapon attack or one shove.
If you covered 10 ft or more in a straight line just before, a hit deals +5 damage, and a successful shove sends the target as far as 10 ft away.

name: Crossbow Expert
trigger: You attacked with a one-handed weapon in your Attack action
description: After attacking with a one-handed weapon during your Attack action, you may fire a bonus-action shot from a hand crossbow you hold, if it is loaded.

name: Defensive Duelist
trigger: A melee attack hits you while you wield a finesse weapon you are proficient with
description: Add your proficiency bonus to your AC against that one attack. It can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Grappler
description: Roll another grapple check against a creature you already hold. Win it and both of you are restrained until the grapple ends.

name: Great Weapon Master
trigger: On your turn, a melee weapon crit or a kill with a melee weapon
description: Keep the momentum going: your bonus action becomes one more melee weapon attack. It only works during your own turn.

name: Great Weapon Master: Power Attack
trigger: Before a heavy-weapon melee attack
description: Swing for broke with a heavy weapon you're proficient with: accept -5 to the attack roll, and a hit gains +10 damage. Decide before you roll.

name: Healer
description: Burn one use of a healer's kit to heal a creature for 1d6 + 4 plus a number equal to its maximum Hit Dice.
The creature needs a short or long rest before this feat can heal it again.

name: Inspiring Leader
uses: Once per creature per short or long rest
description: Give a 10-minute pep talk to as many as 6 allies within 30 ft, yourself included, who can see or hear and understand you. Each gets temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma modifier.
A given creature cannot be boosted again until a short or long rest.

name: Lucky
description: You have 3 luck points. After rolling an attack, ability check or saving throw (before the outcome), spend one to roll an extra d20 and pick which d20 counts.
You can also spend one when an attack targets you: roll a d20 and choose whether the attack uses its die or yours. Opposing spends on one roll cancel out.

name: Mage Slayer
trigger: A creature no more than 5 ft away casts a spell
description: Make one melee weapon attack against that spellcaster. It uses your reaction, so you get it once per round.

name: Martial Adept
uses: Refill on short or long rest
description: You know 2 Battle Master maneuvers. When one forces a save, the DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (pick one).
You gain one d6 superiority die, or one extra die if you already have some. Spent dice return on a short or long rest.

name: Polearm Master
trigger: You took the Attack action using only a glaive, halberd or quarterstaff
description: Strike with the other end of the weapon: a melee attack dealing a d4 of bludgeoning damage.

name: Polearm Master: Reach Strike
trigger: A creature enters your reach
description: While you hold a glaive, halberd, pike or quarterstaff, you get an opportunity attack against any creature as it comes within your reach.

name: Savage Attacker
trigger: Damage for your melee weapon attack is rolled
description: Roll the weapon's damage dice a second time, then pick which of the two totals counts.

name: Sentinel
trigger: A creature within 5 ft attacks a target other than you, and that target does not have this feat
description: Make one melee weapon attack against the attacker, using your reaction. The reaction is spent whether you hit or not.

name: Sharpshooter
trigger: You make a ranged weapon attack
description: Before a ranged attack with a weapon you are proficient with, you can take -5 on the attack roll. If the attack hits, it deals +10 damage.

name: Shield Master
trigger: You took the Attack action on your turn
description: With a shield in hand, use it to shove a creature no more than 5 ft away.

name: Shield Master: Evade
trigger: An effect lets a successful Dexterity save halve the damage
description: Pass that Dexterity save and you take no damage at all, ducking behind your shield. This needs you to be able to act (not incapacitated).

name: Tavern Brawler
trigger: On your turn you hit with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon
description: Attempt to grapple the creature you just hit, using your bonus action. The usual grapple check applies.

name: War Caster
trigger: A hostile creature's movement gives you an opportunity attack
description: Swap the opportunity attack for a spell aimed at the mover. Only a spell with a 1-action casting time that targets just that creature qualifies.

name: Bountiful Luck
trigger: A visible ally no more than 30 ft away rolls a 1 on the d20 of an attack roll, ability check or saving throw
description: The ally rolls that d20 again and has to use the new result. Your own Lucky trait is unusable until your next turn ends.

name: Dragon Fear
description: Roar instead of breathing. Every creature you pick within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier) or is frightened of you for 1 minute. Anyone unable to see or hear you passes automatically. A frightened creature repeats the save whenever it takes damage, ending the fear on a success.

name: Dwarven Fortitude
trigger: You take the Dodge action in combat
description: Roll the Hit Die you spend and add your Constitution modifier. You heal that many hit points, never less than 1.

name: Fade Away
trigger: You take damage
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: You turn invisible by magic until your next turn ends. Attacking, dealing damage or making anyone roll a saving throw ends it early.

name: Flames of Phlegethos
trigger: A spell you cast deals fire damage
description: Flames cloak you until your next turn ends, harming neither you nor your gear. They light the area: bright for 30 ft, then dim for another 30 ft. Any creature within 5 ft whose melee attack hits you takes 1d4 fire damage.
Any 1s on the spell's fire damage dice can be rerolled; you keep the rerolled result, even if it is 1 again.

name: Orcish Fury
trigger: You hit with a simple or martial weapon attack
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Pick one of the weapon's damage dice, roll it again and add it to the damage, as the weapon's damage type.

name: Orcish Fury: Reprisal
trigger: You have just used Relentless Endurance
description: Make one weapon attack.

name: Second Chance
trigger: An attack roll from a creature you can see hits you
uses: Once, then again after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest
description: The attacker has to reroll the attack.

name: Chef
trigger: You take a short rest with ingredients and cook's utensils
description: Cook during the rest for as many as 4 + your proficiency bonus creatures.
When the rest is over, each one who ate and then spends one or more Hit Dice heals an extra 1d8.

name: Chef: Treats
description: Any creature, you included, can eat one of your treats as a bonus action and gains your proficiency bonus as temporary hit points.
A batch takes 1 hour of work or comes with the end of a long rest. Treats spoil 8 hours after you make them.

name: Crusher
trigger: An attack of yours hits a creature and deals bludgeoning damage
description: Move the creature 5 ft into an unoccupied space (no check). It can be at most one size larger than you.
On a critical hit, attack rolls against it also have advantage until your next turn begins. That part is not limited to once per turn.

name: Metamagic Adept
description: You know 2 Metamagic options from the sorcerer list and have 2 sorcery points that can only pay for Metamagic. They add to any sorcery points you already have.
One Metamagic option per spell, unless the option itself allows more.

name: Piercer
trigger: An attack of yours hits a creature and deals piercing damage
description: Roll one damage die of that attack again. You must keep the new number, even if it is lower.
On a critical hit, also roll one more damage die for the extra piercing damage. That part is not limited to once per turn.

name: Poisoner
description: Coat a weapon or a piece of ammunition with poison using a bonus action, not an action.

Your own doses (1 hour with a poisoner's kit and 50 gp of materials make as many as your proficiency bonus) last 1 minute or until a hit. A creature damaged by the coated weapon or ammunition passes a DC 14 Constitution save or takes 2d8 poison damage and is poisoned until your next turn ends.

name: Slasher
trigger: An attack of yours hits a creature and deals slashing damage
description: The creature loses 10 ft of speed until your next turn begins.
On a critical hit, it also has disadvantage on all its attack rolls until your next turn begins. That part is not limited to once per turn.

name: Telekinetic
description: Pick a creature you can see no more than 30 ft away. Unless it passes a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability this feat raised), you slide it 5 ft, either closer to you or farther off.
A creature can choose to fail the save.
